posts.topic: hire a salesperson vs close one more
posts.hook: Before you hire a salesperson, do this math.
posts.caption:
Before you hire a salesperson, do this math.
10 estimates at $25k, you close 3 = $75k. One more yes = +$25k. Same leads, no new salary.
First tour free, link in bio.
#contractor #kitchenremodel #bathroomremodel #remodeling #contractorlife
posts.voice_text: Before you hire a salesperson, do this math. <break time="0.8s" /> A good one costs you around five grand a month. <break time="0.8s" /> Say you give ten estimates a month at twenty-five thousand each. <break time="0.8s" /> You close three. Seventy-five thousand. <break time="0.8s" /> Close just one more, and that's another twenty-five. <break time="0.8s" /> Same leads. Same crew. No new salary. <break time="0.8s" /> Real talk, at some point you do need help selling. <break time="0.8s" /> But first, look at why the other seven say no. <break time="0.8s" /> Most of them couldn't picture the finished room. <break time="0.8s" /> Show them their own room, finished, before you leave. <break time="0.8s" /> Our own remodeling company went from three in ten to five or six in ten. <break time="0.8s" /> Your first tour is free. Link in bio.

posts.hook: "I thought it would look different." Count what that costs.
posts.caption:
"I thought it would look different." Count what that costs.
$1,800 redo + 2 crew days, 3 times a year = $5,400 and 6 lost days.
First tour free, link in bio.
#contractor #kitchenremodel #bathroomremodel #remodeling #contractorlife
posts.voice_text: "I thought it would look different." Count what that costs. <break time="0.8s" /> Cabinets are in. The client hates the color. <break time="0.8s" /> Say redoing it costs you eighteen hundred dollars. <break time="0.8s" /> Plus two days your crew isn't on the next job. <break time="0.8s" /> If that happens three times a year, that's fifty-four hundred. <break time="0.8s" /> And six lost crew days. <break time="0.8s" /> Real talk, some clients change their minds no matter what. <break time="0.8s" /> But most just never saw it before you built it. <break time="0.8s" /> A color chip isn't a kitchen. <break time="0.8s" /> Show them their own room, finished, before you order a thing. <break time="0.8s" /> Our own remodeling company went from three in ten to five or six in ten. <break time="0.8s" /> Your first tour is free.
